topics.name: Design engineering craft
topics.description: How an interface detail was built: implementation technique, craft process or a worked teardown of a polished UI.

topics.name: HCI research
topics.description: Human-computer interaction research with a method and results: user studies, experiments and papers on interaction techniques.

topics.name: UI components and primitives
topics.description: Accessible building blocks and component libraries such as dialog, popover, drawer, combobox and design tokens, including their releases.

topics.name: AI interaction patterns
topics.description: Interface and interaction patterns for AI products: chat and agent interfaces, streaming, correction, interruption and generative UI.

topics.name: CSS, canvas and motion
topics.description: Concrete techniques in CSS, SVG, canvas, WebGL, shaders or animation, with code or a demo.

topics.name: Frontier model releases
topics.description: A release, model card, benchmark result or technical report for a frontier AI model.

topics.name: Developer tool launches
topics.description: A launch or major release of a developer tool, framework, library, editor, CLI or platform feature.

topics.name: Taste and design philosophy
topics.description: Essays and talks about taste, craft, design principles and how to think about designing and building interfaces.

topics.name: Venture capital and gossip
topics.description: Funding rounds, valuations, acquisitions, investor commentary and industry gossip.

topics.name: Generic AI hype
topics.description: Top-N tool lists, productivity promises and marketing language with no specific technique or finding.

topics.name: Consumer tech releases
topics.description: Consumer technology releases and the news around them: phones, laptops, wearables, chips, operating systems and the rules that shape them.

topics.name: Design
topics.description: Product, UI, UX and visual design news and essays for a designer: interface and interaction design, usability research, design systems, branding and the craft and practice of design. Not architecture, furniture or interiors.

topics.name: Trending
topics.description: A news story that several major outlets are covering at once, in any field: politics, economy, science, health, technology, world events. Not sports results, celebrity gossip, obituaries of no wider interest, local crime, opinion columns or product reviews.

topics.name: World
topics.description: International news and world affairs: conflicts, diplomacy, elections and governments, disasters and humanitarian crises, and major events in any country.

topics.name: Business
topics.description: Business and economic news: markets, companies, earnings, deals, jobs, trade, prices, interest rates and the policies that move them.

topics.name: Science
topics.description: Science and health news: research findings, space, climate and the environment, medicine and public health, reported from a study or an expert.

topics.name: Culture
topics.description: Arts and culture news: film, television, music, books, art, games and the trends around them. Not sports results.

topics.name: Sports
topics.description: Sports news: results, tournaments, transfers, records and the stories around teams and athletes in major sports.
